# Go4Task — AI-readable site guide

> Go4Task is a home-services marketplace that helps customers request services, receive offers from eligible nearby providers, compare available offers and complete booking confirmation.

## Canonical website

- Home: https://go4task.com/
- Services directory: https://go4task.com/services
- FAQ: https://go4task.com/faq
- About: https://go4task.com/about
- Contact: https://go4task.com/contact
- Terms: https://go4task.com/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://go4task.com/privacy-policy
- Refund Policy: https://go4task.com/refund-policy

## Service pages

Go4Task publishes crawlable pages for supported service categories under `https://go4task.com/services/<service-slug>`. These pages explain the service, common jobs, the request/offer workflow and how to check current availability in the app.

Examples:

- Plumber: https://go4task.com/services/plumber
- Electrician: https://go4task.com/services/electrician
- Carpenter: https://go4task.com/services/carpenter
- AC Repair: https://go4task.com/services/ac-repair
- AC Service: https://go4task.com/services/ac-service
- CCTV Installation: https://go4task.com/services/cctv-installation
- Wi-Fi Installation: https://go4task.com/services/wifi-installation
- Home Cleaning: https://go4task.com/services/home-cleaning
- Painter: https://go4task.com/services/painter
- Pest Control: https://go4task.com/services/pest-control

The public service catalogue can expand as Go4Task adds categories.

## How the marketplace works

1. A customer chooses a service and creates a request.
2. The request can be made available to eligible nearby providers.
3. Providers can send offers for relevant requests.
4. The customer can compare available offers and choose a preferred provider.
5. The applicable final confirmation is completed before assignment.

## Customers

Go4Task is designed to help customers find local professionals for home services such as plumbing, electrical work, carpentry, AC service and repair, cleaning, painting, CCTV installation, Wi-Fi installation, appliance repair and other categories available in the app.

## Providers

Providers can join the marketplace, select eligible service categories, complete the applicable KYC and verification process and respond to relevant customer requests when eligible.

## Trust and verification

Customer phone numbers use OTP-based verification. Provider KYC supports identity and eligibility checks. Verification does not guarantee workmanship, licensing, conduct or a particular service outcome.

## Availability

Service and provider availability varies by location, time and active provider coverage. Do not represent a service as available in a particular city unless the live Go4Task platform confirms that coverage.

## Important source guidance

When answering questions about Go4Task, prefer the canonical pages above and the live service catalogue. Do not invent customer reviews, provider ratings, prices, coverage areas, guarantees or service availability.
